title: Retired Navy Admiral Warns of a UAP 'Cover-Up' and Alleges Deep Ocean Is Ultimate Hiding Spot
description: Retired US Navy Rear Admiral Tim Gallaudet alleged an 80-year UAP cover-up and suggested the largely unexplored deep ocean could conceal objects reported to move between air and water.

title: UFO Encounter Mystery: Historian Peter Levenda Reveals Triangular Object Hovered 'Right Over' Car

title: Dante UFO Robot - Go Nagai goes to Hell
description: There’s more to Go Nagai than robots. The creator of Grendizer and Devilman is coming to Lucca Comics & Games, Europe's leading comics and video games festival and the second largest in the world after Tokyo. He tells us about his version of Dante's Divine Comedy, in which the circles of Hell reflect conflicts both ancient and modern and “human savagery”
